scoring: mean gene z-score, matching previous local TCGA recipe; gene standardization within each target-CM simulation scenario; >=48/60 variable mapped genes
simulation: 10 seeded repetitions x 5 member fractions x 200 cells; with replacement; native heldout counts summed; denominator all 12431 reference genes; log2(CPM+.001)
lineage_control: same parent-lineage counts held fixed across dose within repetition; unavailable nonmember parents explicitly unassessable
limitations: background limited to identities with >=20 heldout cells; modules missing a required member are unassessable; inherited annotation holdout, not patient/source-independent; simulations are not biological replicates; no P values; RNA depth and TME-only mixing do not validate tumour purity, gene length/TPM transfer, clinical prediction or physical niche
